diagnosis: The pager fallback wraps borrowed stdout in a TextIOWrapper. When that wrapper is finalized, it closes the stream owned by CliRunner. PR #3482 added an initial borrowed-stream wrapper; PR #3533 completed the fix by keeping the stream open and detaching the temporary wrapper safely.
label_note: Human-curated from both merged pull requests because the first fix was partial. Changed-file labels are proxies, and diagnosis correctness needs separate human review. Never pass this file to the agents.
evaluation_note: The original issue report gives a reproducer and stack trace but does not name the implementation file. The final fix was a two-PR sequence; labels include changed files from both PRs. Treat this as a small benchmark case, not evidence of general accuracy.
